# grpc-httpjson-transcoding / http_template_fuzz_test

grpc-httpjson-transcoding's own fuzz target `http_template_fuzz_test` ([source](source/http_template_fuzz_test.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over grpc-httpjson-transcoding (grpc-ecosystem/grpc-httpjson-transcoding at a6e226f9).

Parses the input as an HTTP path template with HttpTemplate::Parse and discards the result (a null unique_ptr on failure).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against grpc-httpjson-transcoding at commit a6e226f9.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch grpc-httpjson-transcoding` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.
